༄༅/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dmigs med thugs rje mkha' ltar dag pa

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi mdzad pa bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dmigs med thugs rje mkha' ltar dag pa yi/ /'phrin las mchog gi 'gro ba'i dpal gyur pa/ /srid gsum re ba yongs su rdzogs gyur pa/ /rin chen mchog gyur bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /de la da ltar gyi bskal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis byung ba la sngar sangs rgyas gsum byon nas 'dir sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa yin/ ston pa de'i yab rgyal po zas gtsang ma yum sgyu ma lha mdzes kyi sras don grub zhes bya bar skye ba bzhes te/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ ston pa de yang nang ltar du rdo rje 'chang du gyur te/ dang po rgyal po in+t+ra bo dhi la sogs pa'i gdul bya 'dod chags can rnams kyi don du/ chos rgyud sde bzhi la sogs pa gsungs/ 'khor khro bo dang khro mo sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams yin la/ dus srid pa tha ma'i dus nas 'jig rten las 'das/ sangs rgyas kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga'o/ /ston pa de la ci'i phyir rdo rje 'chang zhes brjod na/ chos nyid rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'chang bas na rdo rje 'chang zhes gsungs te/ ji skad du rdo rje 'chang zhes gsungs te snyam na/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes dang / /byang chub sems ldan gang yin pa/ /de nyid rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi bdag /ces so/ /de nas spangs pa dang rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'i sangs rgyas te/ phyi ltar du shākya thub pa/ nang ltar du rdo rje 'chang ngo / /de gnyis ka'i rang bzhin chos kyi sku sku gsum gyi bdag nyid sangs rgyas te/ dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ de yang ci zhe na/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'di/ /snying rje chen po'i rtsa ba can/

/byang chub sems kyi rgyu dang ni/ /ldan pa'i stobs kyis mthar phyin no/ /zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas phal po che'i mdo las/ byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o/ /zhes dang / mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces so/ /bar du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rnam gnyis bsags pa yin te/ de yang rdo rje bkod pa las/ bsod nams tshogs ldan gzugs kyi sku/ /ye shes tshogs ldan mnyam nyid sku/ /btsal nas thon pa ma yin te/ /rgyu'i dus su 'bras bu'i tshogs/ /zhes so/ /tha ma mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa ste/ de yang lang kar gshegs pa las/ bya ba dang ni mtshan nyid dang / /dngos por mya ngan nga mi 'da'/ /bzlog pa'i mya ngan nga 'da'o/ /zhes so/ /de yang mdo las/ sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa'i mtshan smos kyang / mtshan brjod las/sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag /ces sku lngar bshad do/ /mngon rtogs rgyan las/ ngo bo nyid dang longs spyod rdzogs/ /byas dang de bzhin sprul pa de/ /chos sku'i mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ /rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag ldan/ /zhes pas sku bzhir bshad do/ /gsang 'dus las/ rtogs pa longs spyod mtshan nyid can/ /'dus ma byas pa chos kyi sku/ /sna tshogs snang ba sprul pa'i sku/ /sku gsum thob par gdon mi za/ /zhes sku gsum du bshad pa dang / rgyud bla ma las/ 'dus ma byas bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ /mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan/ /don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces pas sku gnyis su bstan to/ /rdo rje gcod pa las/ gang zhig nga la gzugs su mthong / /gang dag nga la sgrar shes pa/ /log par rtog par zhugs pa ste/ /skye bo de yis nga mi mthong / /'dren pa rnams ni chos kyi sku/ /chos nyid du ni yang dag ltos/ /zhes sku gcig tu yang bshad do/

/'o na de rnams mi mthun pa ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'ang bsdus pa'i yon tan phyogs re la dgongs nas gsungs pa'o/ /'o na sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa de rang ji lta bu gcig yin na/ gsang 'dus las/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /chos bdag med pa mnyam nyid pa/ /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pas/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /de yang rang don snyug ma chos kyi sku/ /spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang la gnas pa'o/ /de lta bu'i ngang la gnas kyang sngon gyi smon lam rnam par dag pa dang / thugs rje chen po'i stobs kyis gzhan don du sku rnam pa gnyis kyi tshul du bstan te/ de yang rang gang dang gang la mos pa la de dang de'i gzugs su bstan nas sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /de yang rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa las/ mos pa du ma'i sems can la/ /spyod pa sna tshogs ston mdzad pa/ /sna tshogs tshul gyi gdul bya la/ /thabs ni sna tshogs ston pa yin/ /zhes so/ /gzugs sku gnyis kyi rten chos sku yin par yang dus 'khor las/ dpal ldan dag pa la ni chos kyi sku/ /sku ni yin te longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku las so/ /longs spyod las ni rgyal ba'i bdag po sprul pa yin/ /sku ni yin te sems can rnams kyi don rgyud las/ /zhes so/ /de ltar dmigs med kyi sku gsum gtan la dbab ste/ de la don brgyad de/ sku gsum gyi rnam par gzhag pa dang / ngo bo dang nges tshig dang / dbye ba dang mtshan nyid dang / gang gnas 'gyur ba'i 'bras bu ji ltar thob dang / des chos gang bsdus te gang la gnas pa dang / sku gsum gyi tshang tshul lo/ /dang po sku gsum gyi rnam par gzhag pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sku gsum bdag gi sangs rgyas nyid/ /sku bsdus par ni shes byas te/ /sku gsum bdag gi rang bzhin gyi/ /don ni rten dang bcas par 'dod/

/ces so/ /sku gsum gyi ngo bo ni chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /ci zhe na gsang 'dus le'u brgyad pa las/ ma skyes pa'i chos rnams ni/ /ngo bo nyid kyi khyad par can/ /rnam par mi rtog yang dag pas/ /ye shes 'byung ba rab tu bshad/ /nges tshig ni 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi rten du gyur pas chos sku'o/ /ci zhe na mdo sde rgyan las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku dbye ba/ /rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / /gzhan gyis sprul pa'i sku yin te/ /dang po gnyis po'i rten yin no/ /zhes so/ /'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad longs spyod cing / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad rdzogs nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du ston pa rdo rje 'chang gi rten du gyur pa'i longs sku'o/ /ci zhe na/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ mtshan gzhi sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /dpe byad brgyad cu rtsa gnyis dang / /dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag nyid de/ /theg chen nye bar longs spyod phyir/ /thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhed/ /ces so/ /yon tan de yang rang bzhin med bzhin du mi rtag bzhin du'am/ 'gyur bzhin du sna tshogs sprul nas ston pa'i brten du gyur pa ni/ sprul pa'i sku'o/ /ci zhe na yang / gang gi srid pa ji srid bar/ /'gro la phan pa sna tshogs su/ /mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni/ /thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad/ /ces so/ /dbye na gsum ste/ gzhi rang bzhin gyi sku gsum dang / lam nyams su myong ba'i sku gsum dang / 'bras bu shugs las 'byung ba'i sku gsum dang / gzhi la sku gsum gnas pa yang / mtshan brjod las/ mchog gi dang po sku gsum 'chang / /zhes pas nang bcud kyi sems can la yang sku gsum rang bzhin gyis tshang ste/ shi ba chos sku/ bar do longs sku/ skye ba sprul sku'o/ /de yang gsang 'dus le'u bcu pa las/ khams gsum sems can sgo gsum rdo rje 'chang /

/sku gsung thugs 'dus mnyam pa nyid du bsgom/ /zhes so/ /phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la yang sku gsum rang bzhin gyis tshang ste/ nam mkha' chos sku/ 'byung ba bzhi longs sku/ de la kha dog sna tshogs su 'byung ba ni sprul sku'o/ /de yang nam mkha' che las/ 'byung ba chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /chub par gnas par byang chub sems/ /'gro ba kun la rang bzhin gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lam nyams su myong ba'i sku gsum ni/ rang gi sems nam mkha' lta bu dag pa'i ngang la gnas pa chos sku'o/ /de las dal gyis lhar ldang ba longs sku'o/ /de las 'od zer spro bsdu la sogs byed pa sprul sku'o/ /de yang rtsa rgyud le'u bcu pa las/ chos kyi sku ni lus can du/ /gang tshe sgrub pa por gyur pa/ /de ltar legs sems gyur pa las/ /de tshe ye shes sku ngas bshad/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i lus can du/ /gang tshe sgrub pa por gyur pa/ /de nas mnyam par bzhag pa las/ /longs spyod rdzogs par nga rab smra/ /sprul pa'i sku ni lus can du/ /gang tshe sgrub pa por gyur pa/ /de tshe sems ni rtse gcig pas/ /sprul pa'i sku yang nga smra ste/ /ye shes longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul/ /yang dag thob par gdon mi za/ /bdag nyid shrī he ru kar ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces so/ /'bras bu shugs las byung ba'i sku gsum ni/ gzhi rang bzhin gyis gnas pa de nyid/ bla ma'i gdams ngag nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu mi 'dod kyang shugs las 'byung ste/ dper na so nam tshul bzhin byas pas 'bras dkar mo lo legs na phug ma zhor la 'ong ba dang 'dra'o/ /de yang chos sku nam mkha' lta bu las gzugs sku'i snang ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa byung nas/ gdul bya sems can nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i don byed pa'o/ /de'ang gser 'od dam pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying pos gsol ba/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes la rnam par rtog pa mi mnga' ba bzhin du 'phrin las la mnga' brnyes pa lags bsam/

bka' bstsal pa dper na nyi zla dang chu dang me long la rtog pa med pa bzhin du/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes la rtog pa med kyang smon lam gyi dbang gis sems can skal ba can dag la gzugs kyi sku gnyis kyis don byed pa'o/ /sprul pa'i sku ni phung po lhag mar bcas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /zhes pa dang yang phal po che'i mdo las/ yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal po ni/ /ji ltar yid bsam rdzogs byed pa/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas chos nyid kyang / /rtag tu smon lam rdzogs pas 'grub/ /de yi smon lam de dag gis/ /phyogs bcu de dag rgyal bas gang / /zhes so/ /mtshan nyid ni yan lag bdun dang ldan pas te/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med/ ces so/ /gsang 'dus las/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas gsungs te/ sku gsum ka la sbyor ro/ /gang gnas 'gyur ba'i 'bras bu thob pa ni/ rgyu sems can gyi dus na kun gzhi rnam par shes pa dang / nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnas su gyur pa dang / ye shes kyi tshogs mi rtag pa bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'o/ /dus nam thob na/ bden pa mthong ba'i dus na thob pa'o/ /de yang rnam snang mngon byang las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ting nge 'dzin/ /stong pa nyid bcas rgyal bas bshad/ /de ni sems yongs shes pa las/ /thob par 'gyur gyi gzhan ma yin/ /zhes so/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnas 'gyur ba dang / rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa dang / bskyed rim bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'o/ /de yang sa bcu'i mdo las/ skyed pa'i rim pa lhar gsal nas/ /bsod nams tshogs kyang rdzogs par bshad/ /ces so/ /sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa gnas 'gyur ba dang / rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa dang 'od zer gyi spro bsdu las sprul sku thob pa'o/ /bsod nams bsags pa'i gzugs sku 'byung bar/

lung las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs kyi sku/ /bsod nams tshogs las byung bas te/ /de phyir bsod nams bsags pa zhes/ /de yang yang dang yang du bsags/ /de yang mi'i rten gyis bsags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /thog mar gang thob na/ thog mar chos sku thob nas/ gzugs sku gnyis rim bzhin no/ /de las bzlog pa ni mi srid do/ /gser 'od dam pa las/ rigs kyi bu sprul pa'i sku ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la rten te mngon par snang ngo / /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni chos kyi sku la rten te mngon par snang ngo / /chos kyi sku ni yang dag pas te/ ci la yang mi gnas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /chos sku las gzugs sku byung na/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu gzugs sku 'byung ngo / /zhe na de ni 'dod pas te/ chos sku'i yon tan 'phrin las kyi snang ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzugs sku gnyis rang dus nam 'byung zhe na/ sa dang po nas kyang cha shas tsam 'byung la/ mi slob pa'i dus nas ni rdzogs par 'byung ngo / /de la chos gang bsdus te gang la snang ba ni/ kun rdzob 'khor ba'i chos thams cad gzugs skus bsdus la/ don dam pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad ni/ chos skus bsdus te/ de'i phyir bden pa gnyis sam 'khor 'das gnyis dbyer med de/ de la zung 'jug gi sku zhes bya ste tha mi dad do/ /de yang slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /rtog pa gnyis po spangs nas ni/ /gang du dngos po gcig gyur pa/ /zung du 'jug bcas de la bshad/ /ces so/ /de gang la snang na/ sa dang po yan chad kyi mnyam bzhag la chos sku spros pa thams cad dang bral bar snang / dag pa sa gsum la gnas pa'i rjes shes la longs sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan par snang / sa bdun pa man chad kyi rjes shes dang / tshogs lam yan chad du sprul skur snang ngo / /de yang pun dha ri ka'i mdo las/ 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed phrag dgu'i 'jig rten gyi khams re re na yang /

thugs rje chen po stong rtsa gnyis su sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad par bshad do/ /sems can mos pa spyod pa'i sa rnams la/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis thams cad du khyab kyang / blun rmongs kyis mi mthong ba'am/ rgyal po mu khyud 'dzin la 'phags pa 'jam dpal bstan yang / khyi rgan las ma mthong ba lta bu yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ yon tan mi zad mnyam med ldan/ /'jig rten dag dang dkyil 'khor du/ /snang ba lha dang mi rnams kyis/ /snang ba kun du mi mthong ngo / /zhes so/ /'o na sangs rgyas rnams kyi snang ba la phyogs ris yod pa'am/ yang na ma byon pa yin nam/ zhe na ma yin te/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ lha'i rgyal pos char phab kyang / /sa bon rul pa mi 'khrungs ltar/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten byon gyur kyang / /skal ba med pas bzang mi mthong / /zhes so/ /sku gsum po gang zag gcig la tshang tshul ni/ bstan pa'i gtso bo shākya thub pa de/ bskal pa grangs med 'das pa'i sngon rol du sangs rgyas pa de chos sku'o/ /gzugs sku gnyis ni/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa po gcig 'dir sangs rgyas/ /zhes so/ /sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthu dang / thugs rje'i shugs kyis gzhan don du sku rnam pa gnyis bstan te/ de las kyang gdul bya dag pa'i 'khor sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ mtshan dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bstan te/ longs sku de la nges pa lnga'i sgo nas don byed de gnas nges pa ni/ 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su gzugs khams kyi rten nas sangs rgyas tshul bstan te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /zhes pa dang / de nyid 'dus pa las/ chu bo na ran dzā na'i drung du dka' thub mdzad pa'i dus su/ de bzhin gshegs pa til gyi gang bu tsam 'jig rten du lhags nas/ rdo rje dbyings zhes bya ba'i ming gi dbang bskur nas/

lha'i gnas su seng ge'i khri la zhal kun tu bstan nas bzhag go /zhes pa'am/ yang na 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bkod pa phun tshogs pa dang ldan pa rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga zhes bya ba'i gnas so/ /ston pa zhes te/ sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan nam/ rigs rnam pa lnga'i bdag nyid du bzhugs pa yin te/ de yang saṃ bu ṭa las/ stong pa'i rdo rje can gcig ni/ /rigs ni rnam pa lnga ru 'gyur/ /zhes pa stong pa nyid rdo rje'i rigs yin la de la bdag gzhan gyi dgos 'dod 'byung bas rin po che'i rigs so/ /de la 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pas pad+ma'i rigs so/ /des sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las thams cad byed pas las kyi rigs so/ /des mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad gcod pas 'khor lo'i rigs kyang yin no/ /khyad par du'ang / ston pa shākya thub pa nyid/ gdul bya 'dod chags can rnams la rigs lnga 'dus pa drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi skur snang ba'o/ /rdo rje 'chang de rang bzhin ji lta bu zhe na/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ rdo rje 'chang zhes gsungs pa ci/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes dang / /byang chub sems ldan gang yin pa/ /de nyid rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi bdag /ces gsungs so/ /yang ci'i phyir zhe na/ rdo rje 'chang zhes brjod/ sra zhing snying po khong stong med/ /srog med gcad du med pa dang / /gzhig cing gzhom du med pa dang / /stong pa nyid ni rdo rjer brjod/ /ces so/ /da ltar rtogs ldan rnams kyang rdo rje 'chang du gyur ro/ /stong pa nyid rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'chang ba'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'dod pa ste/ de nyid las/ rdo rje stong pa rnam nyid du/ /phyogs rnams thams cad kun khyab pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa ni/ /chos dbyings dang mnyam thug pa med/ /rdo rje 'chang rnams de nyid do/ /zhes so/ /'o na der nyer len gyi phung po lnga bzung nas/

tha mal pa'i gzugs su 'ong bar mi rigs so snyam na/ gur las/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' zhes/ /de nyid slob dpon gzugs bzung ste/ /sems can phan gdags dmigs nas ni/ /tha mal pa yi gzugs su gnas/ /zhes so/ /de rnams rdo rje 'chang yin na/ rgyud gsungs pa rigs so zhe na/ de ni phun sum tshogs pa dang mi ldan te/ bstan pa 'jig pa'i dus su chos gsungs pa ni/ dus 'chol ba'i phyir dang / bstan pa gcig la ston pa gnyis mi 'ong ba'i phyir dang / 'khor nges pa ni khro bo khro mo la sogs pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'am dag pa'i sa gsum la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rigs gsum mgon po rnams la gsungs so/ /ston pa dang 'khor gnyis ka rang bzhin gcig yin te/ brtag gnyis las/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga / /rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga / /zhes so/ /chos nges pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis sems can nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs kyang / bsdus na theg pa gsum las/ nyan rang dang / pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sngags rig pa 'dzin pa'o/ /de yang mtshan brjod las/ theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ /zhes so/ /de la sngags kyi theg pa 'di ni/ theg pa gsum pa'o/ /theg pa chen po gcig pur nges pa'i rgyun mtshan yang yod de/ ye shes grags pa'i de kho na 'jug pa las/ chos dbyings dbye ba ma mchis pas/ /gtso bo theg dbye yod min gyis/ /khyed kyi theg pa gnyis gsungs pa/ /sems can rnams ni 'jug pa'i phyir/ /zhes so/ /'o na chos de ga nas byung snyam na/ dam pa'i chos gsungs pa'i dus dang / gnas pa'i dus dang / 'jig pa'i dus dang / gsum las dang po'i dus der/ brjod bya gsang sngags bla na med pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde'i don/ rjod byed tshig gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod rgyud sde rin po che bzhi'i don du gsungs pa'o/

/de yang sngags kyi theg pa ni/ tshe gcig la sangs rgyas te/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ bskal pa bye bar rnyed dka' ba'i/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang bcom ldan la/ /tshe 'di nyid la ster bas na/ /'bras bu can gyi ming nas 'bod/ /ces so/ /dus nges pa ni/ longs sku 'das grongs mi mnga' bar dus rtag du bzhugs pa ni/ 'khor gyi snang ba dag pa'o/ /de yang mdo mya ngan 'das pa nas/ sangs rgyas mya ngan mi 'da' zhing / /chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /sprul pa'i sku ni 'dir sangs rgyas/ /zhes pa ni/ rdo rje gdan du mis rten la brten nas sangs rgyas tshul bstan pa ni/ ma nges pa lnga'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed do/ /de ltar yang 'phrin las rdzogs pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas ni sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid yin te/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i phyir/ sa bon las myu gu skye ba bzhin no/ /de yang gnas ma nges pa ni/ da ltar gyi bstan pa ni chags pa'i dus su/ sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis 'byung ba'i snga ltas su/ snying rje chen po pad+ma dkar po las/ chu'i phung po'i nang na yar la pad+ma stong rtsa gnyis 'byung ste/ de la gzugs khams kyi lha rnams kyis/ bskal pa ni bzang po'o/ /zhes brjod pas de ltar grags pa'o/ /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi sprul pa/ rgyal po yul 'khor skyong gi sras stong rtsa gnyis sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa 'byung ste/ de yang pun dha ri ka'i mdo las/ ji ltar 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung bye ma snyed phrag dgu'i 'jig rten gyi khams re re na yang / thugs rje chen pos sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis su sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad par bshad do/ /de yang rnam par gzigs dang gtsug tor mnga' ba dang / thams cad skyob dang / 'khor ba 'jig dang / gser thub dang / 'od srung dang drug song nas/ 'di rgyal ba shākya thub pa yin te/ gdul bya zhing khams kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i nyon mongs pa rnams dang /

mi mjed pa'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya'o/ /de yang rdo rje gdan la sogs pa 'dzam bu'i gling bye ba phrag brgyad rigs drug gi gnas su byon te/ snying rje rol pa rnam par rgyal ba'i mdo las/ stong gsum mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'dzam bu'i gling bye ba phrag brgyad mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad ces so/ /ston pa ma nges pa ni/ gdul bya ma dag pa brgyud drug gi sems can rnams la/ de yang rang gi snang tshul dang bstun nas gang dang gang gis 'dul ba la de'ang de'i skur bstan nas sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ rgyal byin tshangs pa'i cha byad dang / /la lar bdud kyi cha byad kyis/ /sems can rnams kyi don mdzad de/ /'jig rten rnams kyi rtogs mi nus/ /zhes so/ /yang la lar bltams pa yongs su bstan/ la lar ni 'khor lo bskor/ la lar spyad pa spyod pa mdzad/ ces so/ /sprul sku de la dbye na gsum ste mdo sde rgyan las/ bzo dang skye dang dka' thub che/ /zhes pas/ byang chub chen po'i sprul pa rgyal ba shākya thub pa ste/ de la bzhed pa gzhung mi mthun pa gsum ste/ 'phags pa nyan thos pa skye ba 'di la sangs rgyas par 'dod de/ dbu ma pa skye ba gcig gis thob pa'i byang chub sems par byed/ gsang sngags pa sprul sku yin par bzhed do/ /de yang mdzad pa mthar 'don gyi sangs rgyas zhes bya ste/ mchog gi sprul pa'o/ /de yang 'di skad du/ kye sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs gsang ba snying po bla med de nyag gcig po 'dzam gling snod dang ldan pa'i nges don 'gro/ lha mi'i ston pa byams pa mgon gyis mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs nas/ ri rab rtse mo la byon nas/ gzigs pa rnam pa lnga la gzigs te/ gling dang yul dang grong khyer dang rigs dang yum la gzigs pa'o/ /de nas mi'i yul du mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan te/

mdo rgya cher rol pa las/ dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / /lhums su zhugs dang bltams pa dang / /bzo'i gnas la mkhas pa dang / /gzhon nu rol rtsed mdzad pa dang / /btsun mo 'khor gyis rol pa dang / /nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang / /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / /bdud sde 'joms mdzad sangs rgyas dang / /chos 'khor mya ngan 'das ston dang / /zhes mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan pa'o/ /bzo'i sprul pa ni shing bzo dang lha bzo la sogs pa 'jig rten phan dgu thams cad mdzad de mchog bzo'i bhi sho skar ma lta bu'am/ dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' btul ba'i lo rgyus bzhin no/ /skye ba'i sprul pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyang skye ba'i sprul pa ste/ saṃ bu ṭa las/ zla ba bcu ni sa rnams nyid/ /sems can sa bcu'i dbang phyug go /zhes so/ /zhang mdo sde skyes rabs las gsungs pa lta bu'am/ bya bar sprul pa'i lo rgyus so/ /rin chen stug po las/ skyes pas 'dul ba la ni/ skyes pa dang / bud med kyis 'dul ba rnams la bud med dang zhes pa dang / yab dang sras mjal ba las/ bud med na chung spyod pa mdzad/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas rnams na'ang gda'/ /'jig rten chos kyis ma gos te/ /pad+ma chus mi chags pa bzhin/ /zhes so/ /skyes bu thor bu ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen du sprul nas kyang sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /bla ma mtshan ldan de sangs rgyas dngos rang yin no/ /sdom pa 'byung ba las/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /bla ma dam pa mchog nyid la/ /bdag nyid gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'o/ /dkon mchog gsum yang tshang ba'o/ /de la sangs rgyas yin na nyer len gyi phung po lnga bzung nas tha mal pa'i gzugs su ston pa mi rigs so/ /zhe na/ ār+ya de ba'i gcod bsdus las/ ji ltar phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang po/ /de yi sku la sha rus rkang med kyang / /sems can phan phyir khams la 'jug mdzad cing /

/sprul pa'i sku yis bya ba mdzad pa yin/ /zhes so/ /sems can re re la sprul pa re re 'byung ste/ chu snod re la zla ba res khyab pa bzhin no/ /sprul sku des sems can gyi don ji tsam zhe na/ 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du mdzad do/ /lung las/ ji srid nam mkha' gnas kyi bar/ /gzhan don 'khor bar 'khor byed kyang / snying rje can rnams ci te skyo/ /zhes ston pa gnyis kyi snang ba ni/ ngo bo gcig la theg pa gnyis kyi gdul bya snang tshul so sor 'byung ba ni/ rdo rje a ra li'i rgyud las/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i khyad par gyis/ /pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa dang / /sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su gsungs/ /zhes so/ /'khor ma nges pa ni/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad gdul bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa las/ 'dul byed kyi sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig byung pa'o/ /de la sprin rgyud gsum pa las/ bde gshegs slob mar gyur pa'i 'gro drug dag /'jig rten khams na gnas pa kun nyon cig /deng 'dir ston pa chos kyi char 'bebs kyis/ /gang dag ma lus par ni 'dir gshegs shig /ces pa nad pa sman pa g.yog po'i dpe bzhin no/ /chos ma nges pa ni/ theg pa sna tshogs su gsungs te/ bzang spyod las kyang / lha'i skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad/ /grul bum skad dang mi'i skad rnams dang / /'gro ba kun gyi sgra skad ji tsam par/ /thams cad skad du bdag gis chos ston to/ /zhes pas sprul pa'i sku des srid pa gsum du chos ston pa'o/ /ji lta bu zhig ston na/ de yang sems can gyi rgyud la/ nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong rgyu ste/ 'dod chags las gyur pa nyi khri chig stong / zhe sdang dang gti mug dang de gsum cha mnyam pa las kyang de bzhin no/ /de'i gnyen por yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba des/ chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong bka' stsal te/

'dod chags la 'dul ba nyis khri chig stong / de bzhin du zhe sdang la mdo sde/ gti mug la mngon pa/ de gsum cha mnyam pa la sngags rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod nyis khri chig stong ste/ brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs te/ de yang bsdus na/ drang don dang / nges don/ snying po'i skor dang gsum las/ de yang bka' 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor ba la 'dul ba las/ dang po wa ra nā ser drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa lan gsum du rnam pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du bskor ba dang / gnyis pa bya rgod phung po'i ri la sogs par/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi 'khor lo gnyis ka yang / bla na ma mchis pa skabs ma mchis pa'i drang don ste/ rtsod pa gzhi'i dus su gnas gyur pa'o/ /gsum pa lha'i gnas gsum mam/ btsun mo'i bha khar bcom ldan 'das kyi chos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ma mchis pa las brtsam pa shin tu ngo mtshar smad du byung ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor te/ 'di ni bla na ma mchis pa'o/ /skabs ma mchis pa nges pa'i don gsungs te/ rtsod gzhi'i gnas su gyur pa ma lags so/ /zhes dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' don dam yang dag 'phags kyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar gsungs pa'o/ /de la 'di ni chos 'khor gsum pa sngags so/ /dus ma nges pa ni/ sku tshe ring pas phan pa la ring pa/ thung pas phan pa la thung pa'o/ /de yang la lar med bzhin mya ngan 'da'/ /la lar byang chub sangs yang rgya/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni rtag pa'i sku/ /nam yang med pa ma yin no/ /zhes so/ /'das grong mnga' ba ni 'khor gyi snang ba ma dag pas skyon yin te/ de yang mchog gi sprul pa rgyal ba shākya thub pa de dgung lo brgyad cu la mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan pa la/ btsun pas gsol ba btab pas zla gsum lo gnyis nur te/ brgyad cu rtsa gnyis la mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan te/

gser 'od dam pa las/ sangs rgyas mya ngan mi 'da' zhing / /chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur te/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' tshul bstan/ /zhes so/ /de la sangs rgyas kyi 'khor dpag tu med pa'i nang nas/ bka' sdud pa po yang / sngags kyi sdud pa po byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjer grags pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la ni kun dga' bor grags pa ste/ de nyid kyang ngo bo gcig la snang tshul tha dad pa ste/ bsil ba tshal gyi mdo las/ mang du thos shing gsang sngags 'chang / /kun dga' bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas 'khor rnams kyis sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di sus 'dzin zhus pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ sa ra ha dang klu sgrub gnyis kyis 'dzin gsungs te/ grong khyer wa ra na ser/ sa ra ha 'byon par gsungs pa ni/ mdo sde gsung bkod pa las gsal te/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /lo ni brgya dang bcu gnyis na/ /lho phyogs dpal gyi ri bo la/ /sa ra ha zhes bya ba yis/ /snying po don gyi bstan pa 'dzin/ /zhes pa dang / klu sgrub kyis 'dzin pa yang / mdo sde lang kar gshegs pa las/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /lo ni bzhi brgya lon pa na/ /lho phyogs bhe ta zhes bya bar/ /dge slong klu sgrub zhes bya 'byung / /yod dang med pa'i phyogs spangs pa'i/ /de yis nga yis bstan pa 'dzin/ /zhes so/ /zhing khams rnam dag dkyil 'khor gzhal yas nas/ /dag pa'i 'khor 'dus he ru ka dpal gyis/ /bdag med yum la gnyis med rnam par rol/ /rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar zur tsam 'di/ /brgyud 'dzin rnams kyi rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /ku su lu'i sprang po rmog lcog pas/ /gong ma rnams kyi gsungs la brten nas sbyar/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can rnams/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog/
